name: Hannah Love Lanier
biography: Hannah Love Lanier is an American actress who began acting as a child artist. During her career, she has been cast in a variety of projects such as The Tiny Mighty Club, A Black Lady Sketch Show and Special Ops: Lioness. She started acting at a young age. In April 2022, Hannah Love Lanier was seen as Young Haddassah in an episode titled Save My Edges, I'm a Donor! from the television comedy series A Black Lady Sketch Show. She played the role of Kate (the teenage daughter of Joe and Neil) in the spy television series Special Ops: Lioness in 2023. Hannah Love Lanier starred in the series alongside Zoe Saldaña, Laysla De Oliveira, Dave Annable , Jill Wagner, LaMonica Garrett, James Jordan, Austin Hebert, Jonah Wharton, Stephanie Nur, Nicole Kidman and Morgan Freeman.
